description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Salesforce)
description:
About us

First Line Software works with some of the world's top businesses and organizations across industries such as healthcare, real estate, data engineering, warehouse automation, retail digitalization, mobile app development, and e-commerce.

Our projects are as diverse as our people — and we believe in building software through collaboration, transparency, and shared success.

Let's see what we can create together!


About the project

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer (Salesforce) to join a long-term project and support the improvement of deployment processes across multiple systems, including Salesforce and web applications .

In this role, you will work closely with an existing DevOps setup and client-side leadership, contributing to automation, reliability, and efficient delivery pipelines. This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys improving workflows, reducing manual effort, and working independently within a collaborative environment.


Responsibilities

  • Drive improvements in deployment workflows across Salesforce and other applications, reducing manual steps and increasing reliability
  • Design and implement CI/CD pipelines , including solutions tailored for Salesforce
  • Improve and maintain version control practices to ensure traceability and safe rollbacks

  • Support release management, monitoring, and environment stability (SRE-related tasks)

Requirements

  • Strong experience with DevOps practices and process improvement
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce DX, SF CLI, and Developer Tools , including deployments and configurations
  • Experience building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (YAML/JSON), preferably with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (ARM templates, Bicep, or Terraform)

  • Nice to have: exposure to AWS or GCP

  • Strong understanding of version control systems (Git or similar)
  • Experience supporting release management and monitoring (SRE concepts)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work independently in a distributed team


What we can offer

The FLS difference

  • Our modern stack projects are the right mix of exciting and challenging

title: Analista de TI Sênior (Administrador de Redes)
description:
Somos o maior ressegurador do Brasil. Com mais de 80 anos de experiência, atuamos nas principais linhas de negócios em resseguros e contamos com uma equipe altamente qualificada, pronta para inovar e oferecer os melhores produtos e serviços ao mercado.


Estamos com 1 vaga de Analista de TI Sênior, com foco em Administração de Redes . Confira os detalhes abaixo:


FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA


  • Necessário Superior completo em Engenharia de Redes, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Certificações desejáveis: CCNA, CCNP, Fortinet NSE, CompTIA Network+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Network Engineer Associate.
  • Desejável pós-graduação em Infraestrutura de TI, Segurança da Informação ou Engenharia de Conectividade.


EXPERIÊNCIA/CONHECIMENTOS


  • Imprescindível experiência em administração e suporte de redes corporativas LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud;
  • Conhecimento avançado em roteamento, switching, firewalls, NAT, VLANs, QoS e VPNs;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento e automação de rede (Zabbix, SolarWinds, PRTG, Ansible);
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos e multicloud, com integração entre redes locais e provedores cloud;
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de rede (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, BGP, OSPF);
  • Familiaridade com segurança de rede, criptografia, IDS/IPS, segmentação e controle de acesso;
  • Capacidade de diagnóstico e troubleshooting de incidentes complexos de conectividade;
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e regulados, com requisitos de alta disponibilidade e compliance;
  • Familiaridade com soluções de rede e segurança Cisco, Palo Alto e Trend Micro;
  • Necessário Inglês técnico intermediário (para leitura de documentação e interface com fornecedores globais).



MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO


Garantir a operação estável, segura e eficiente das redes de comunicação de dados e voz do IRB(Re), assegurando disponibilidade, desempenho e confiabilidade dos serviços de conectividade corporativa. É o responsável técnico pela infraestrutura de rede, abrangendo LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls e equipamentos de comunicação, suportando as operações do negócio e garantindo conformidade com as políticas de segurança e governança de TI.

Assegurar a continuidade e a resiliência das redes corporativas, promovendo padronização, automação e melhoria contínua da infraestrutura de conectividade que sustenta os sistemas críticos e o ambiente híbrido do IRB(Re).


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES


Gestão e Operação de Ambientes

  • Administrar e monitorar a rede corporativa LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud, garantindo disponibilidade, estabilidade e desempenho;
  • Configurar, manter e otimizar switches, roteadores, access points, firewalls, balanceadores e VPNs;
  • Monitorar a latência, throughput e integridade dos enlaces de rede, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Executar rotinas de backup e restauração de configurações de rede;
  • Gerenciar e documentar o inventário de equipamentos de rede, seus contratos de manutenção;
  • Apoiar times de Service Desk e Infraestrutura na resolução de incidentes relacionados à conectividade;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de disponibilidade e performance de rede, com reportes regulares à Governança de TI.


Implementação e Melhoria Contínua

  • Planejar e executar projetos de implantação, atualização e expansão de rede, em alinhamento com Engenharia & Plataforma;
  • Definição de escopo técnico para projetos de infraestrutura de redes, visando escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade dos serviços, garantindo o alinhamento entre requisitos técnicos e necessidades de negócio;
  • Avaliar novas tecnologias e padrões de conectividade (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi 6, 5G, Zero Trust Network Access);
  • Automatizar tarefas de configuração e monitoração com uso de ferramentas de gerenciamento de rede e scripts (Ansible, Python, SNMP, etc.);
  • Apoiar a integração de ambientes on-premises e cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) garantindo conectividade segura;
  • Participar da definição de arquiteturas de rede resilientes e escaláveis, em conjunto com Arquitetura Corporativa;
  • Documentar diagramas, topologias e fluxos de rede no repositório corporativo de arquitetura;
  • Realizar testes de carga, failover e redundância em enlaces críticos.


Segurança, Governança e Compliance

  • Operar e gerenciar ferramentas de segurança, como: Endpoint Security, NGFW, PAM, WAF, Cloud Email Security, NAC, DNS Security, de acordo as diretrizes do CISO;
  • Monitorar e responder a alertas de segurança de rede, incidentes e vulnerabilidades, em colaboração com o time de Cyber Service;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de controles e conformidade (LGPD, SUSEP, SOX);
  • Assegurar a execução de atualizações de firmware e patches de segurança nos dispositivos de rede;
  • Gerenciar logs e trilhas de auditoria de equipamentos e soluções de rede;
  • Apoiar o planejamento e execução de planos de continuidade e recuperação de desastres (DRP) para infraestrutura de rede.



BENEFÍCIOS


  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Auxílio creche
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados
  • Previdência privada
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale alimentação e/ou Vale-refeição
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass)

Qualifications

  • Fluency in German (reading, writing, and speaking) is mandatory
  • Strong command of grammar, vocabulary, and stylistic nuances in German

This role strictly requires native or near-native proficiency in German. Applications from candidates without strong German language skills will not be considered.

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Long Term Contract


Description:

In this dynamic position, you'll have the opportunity to drive technological excellence, mentor a high-performing team, and play a key role in transforming business goals into cutting-edge digital experiences. If you are passionate about leading teams, driving innovation, and making a tangible impact, we invite you to lead with us and propel our digital capabilities to new heights.

If you are excited to make a difference applying cutting-edge technologies to solve real business challenges and add value to a global, market-leading organization, please come join us!


Key Interfaces:

Internal: NA Marketing VP, NA Marketing Brands and Product Teams, NA D&A Product Managers; Legal Team, DTS Cloud Team; DTS Enterprise Architecture Team; NA DTS Team.

External: Marketing Agencies, Third Party Providers.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of developers and web technology professionals, fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Oversee the design, development, and deployment of high-quality, scalable web solutions that align with business strategies and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with UX/UI designers, product managers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and delivery of web projects.
  • Implement and enforce best practices in software development, including code quality, performance optimization, and security measures.
  • Drive the adoption of modern technologies and methodologies to enhance the team's capabilities and deliver innovative solutions.
  • Manage timelines, resources, and budgets, ensuring that all initiatives are completed on time and within scope.
  • Lead the strategy for web and digital technology, aligning with organizational goals and driving digital transformation.
  • Stay current with emerging technology trends and integrate relevant advancements into the team's work.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement, encouraging the team to stay ahead of industry trends and technological advancements.
  • Ensure that all development and web solutions comply with relevant data privacy regulations such as CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and other global privacy standards.
  • Implement mechanisms for handling user consent, managing data access controls, and ensuring that all data collection practices align with legal requirements.
  • Act as a point of escalation for technical issues, providing solutions and guiding the team through complex challenges.
  • Collaborate with other engineering managers and leaders to align on technical strategies and share best practices.
  • Report on progress, team performance, and technological advancements to senior leadership.
  • Lead the team's efforts in troubleshooting and resolving issues, ensuring minimal disruption to project timelines.


Required Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in information technology leading remote, global teams across time zones and a minimum of 5 years of experience in product or engineering management.
  • 8+ years of experience and deep understanding of digital marketing technologies is required, specifically in web development.
  • Strong expertise in Sitecore CMS and other web technologies with experience in building, delivering, and operating digital platforms
  • Technical leadership experience with solution architecture, software development, engineering management, and application delivery, including CICD, SDLC, and MACH architecture practices
  • Proven track record in leading and delivering complex digital projects.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and guide a team.
  • Deep understanding of Agile methodologies and project management tools.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make strategic decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong knowledge of data privacy regulations like CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and their implications for web development.
  • Experience implementing data protection mechanisms, including consent management, data encryption, and access controls.
  • Familiarity with One Trust or similar systems privacy and compliance features, including the ability to configure and enforce data protection settings.
  • Proven ability and experience in building highly skilled product teams and mentoring a team of developers.
  • Strong sense of urgency in delivering results and high cross-cultural awareness and sensitivity.
  • Operate as a change agent at multiple levels of an organization with outstanding organizational, communication, interpersonal, relationship-building skills conducive to collaboration at all levels.

Sob supervisão limitada, os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo (MST) instalam, fazem manutenção e reparam equipamentos eletrônicos marítimos a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. Após a conclusão de cada trabalho, o técnico redigirá e enviará um relatório de serviço detalhado.

• Radares

• ECDIS

• Satcoms

• Rádios HF e VHF

• GPS

• Girobússola

• Pilotos automáticos

• Sirenes

• Proficiente em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.

title: Principal Recruiter
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Principal Recruiter based in Latin America with 5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting and proven leadership capabilities. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of recruiters while owning end-to-end talent delivery strategy and execution across multiple roles.


You will partner closely with Sourcing, Client Success, and leadership to deliver high-quality talent, improve recruiting performance, and scale talent operations. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines execution, strategy, and team development.



Responsibilities



Lead & Develop the Recruiting Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters
  • Set clear performance expectations and talent quality standards
  • Provide structured feedback, training, and mentorship
  • Foster a high-performance, accountable, and collaborative team culture
  • Conduct regular 1:1s and support career growth of team members


Own Full-Cycle Recruiting Execution

  • Manage end-to-end recruiting processes from intake to offer
  • Screen, interview, and evaluate candidates for technical and non-technical roles
  • Ensure a high-quality candidate experience throughout the process
  • Partner with sourcing to ensure strong pipeline conversion
  • Oversee offer process and ensure smooth handoff to onboarding

Drive Recruiting Strategy & Client Partnership

  • Lead role intake and align on requirements with stakeholders
  • Translate business needs into structured recruiting strategies
  • Partner with Client Success and Resource Managers to meet talent delivery goals
  • Anticipate challenges and adjust strategies proactively
  • Ensure alignment between client expectations and recruiting execution


Elevate Candidate Evaluation & Talent Quality

  • Define and refine candidate assessment frameworks
  • Implement and oversee technical testing and evaluation processes
  • Ensure consistent and objective candidate selection across roles
  • Maintain high standards for candidate quality and role fit


Drive Operational Excellence

  • Improve recruiting workflows, processes, and documentation
  • Ensure consistency, speed, and quality across talent pipelines
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement process improvements
  • Manage referral programs and internal recruiting initiatives


Leverage Data & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and analyze recruiting metrics (e.g., time to fill, conversion rates)
  • Use data to improve talent delivery outcomes and team performance
  • Identify trends and opportunities for optimization
  • Continuously improve recruiting strategies, tools, and practices



Required Experience



  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting and at least 3+ in a leadership position
  • Experience leading or mentoring recruiters
  • Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation skills
  • Experience managing multiple roles and stakeholders simultaneously
  • Ability to translate business needs into effective talent strategies
  • Familiarity with ATS platforms and recruiting tools
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively


Desired Experience



  • Experience recruiting for technical roles
  • Experience working with North American clients or companies
  • Experience in agency, consulting, or nearshore/offshore recruiting environments
  • Exposure to recruiting analytics, reporting, or process optimization
  • Experience in growth-stage or startup environments


Additional Information



  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let’s learn from them. Be transparent!

Junte-se a nós na BAT e faça parte de um ambiente que prospera no crescimento interno, onde a progressão de sua carreira não é apenas uma declaração – é uma realidade que estamos ansiosos para construir juntos. Aproveite essa oportunidade e seja dono do seu desenvolvimento; seu próximo capítulo começa aqui.
  • Você terá acesso a plataformas de aprendizagem on-line e programas de desenvolvimento personalizados para aprimorar suas habilidades de liderança
  • Priorizamos a melhoria contínua em um ambiente transformador, preparando-nos para mudanças constantes


PORQUÊ JUNTAR-SE À BAT?

Somos uma das poucas empresas nomeadas como Global Top Employer pelo Top Employers Institute - certificada em oferecer excelentes condições aos colaboradores.

A colaboração, a inclusão e a parceria estão na base de tudo o que fazemos na BAT. Estamos ansiosos pra proporcionar que cada indivíduo prospere, independentemente do género, orientação sexual, estado civil, mudança de género, raça, religião ou crença, cor, nacionalidade, origem étnica ou nacional, deficiência, idade, competências, experiência, educação, contexto socioeconómico e profissional, estatuto de veterano, perspectivas e estilos de pensamento. title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Médico Oncologista Genético (com RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ONCOLOGISTA GENÉTICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Oncologia Genética! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Oncologista.

description:

• Domínio da metodologia Ágil;

Considerado diferencial:

title: Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: Senior Frontend Developer (100% Remote Worldwide)
description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.


Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.


Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?


About the job

As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. This includes:

  • New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.
  • Performance - all ui components that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Frontend Development team is responsible for building all the interactions with API services with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.


Responsibilities

Collaborate with the team to work on the development of the Bitfinex KYC webapps. Including:

  • New Features: Create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional KYC experience for customers and compliance officers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies.
  • Scalability: The web application must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Design: Build beautiful reactive applications and trading tools.
  • Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors
  • Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc.


Requirements

  • With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend.
  • Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture.
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts.
  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.
  • Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these.
  • Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via NodeJS, with MongoDB, configuring ports and local environment
  • Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools.
  • Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs.
  • Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life.
  • Interest in modernising and optimising different web applications.


Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. title: Customer Loyalty Specialist
description:
About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Loyalty Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: UI/UX Designer (Salesforce)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,800 - $2,200 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a UI/UX Designer with Salesforce Experience. You will be a champion of the end-user within their Salesforce projects. Your mission is to transform complex business processes into intuitive, high-fidelity digital experiences. You will apply user-centered design principles to the Salesforce platform, ensuring that solutions are not only functional but delightful to use. You will work closely with stakeholders to conduct user research and translate those insights into wireframes and prototypes that adhere to the Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS).


Must-have Technical Skills:

  • Proven Experience: 3+ years of professional UI/UX design experience with a strong portfolio showcasing user-centered design solutions.
  • Design Tools: Mastery of Figma (preferred), Sketch, or Adobe XD for creating high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes. Avonni is a plus.
  • Design Systems: Deep expertise in working with and extending design systems; specifically, a strong working knowledge of the Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS).
  • User Research: Experience conducting user interviews, surveys, and usability testing to validate design decisions.
  • Information Architecture: Ability to create site maps, user task flows, and wireframes that simplify complex Salesforce data structures.
  • Visual Design: Strong eye for typography, color theory, and layout, with a focus on creating accessible and responsive web interfaces.
  • Prototyping: Ability to build click-through prototypes to communicate interactions and transitions to stakeholders and developers.


Salesforce Specific Knowledge:

  • Platform Awareness: Understanding of Salesforce \"Out-of-the-Box\" layout capabilities and limitations (e.g., Lightning App Builder, Page Layouts, and Dynamic Forms).
  • Component-Based Design: Familiarity with how Salesforce components behave to ensure designs are technically feasible for developers to build.
  • Experience Cloud: Knowledge of the branding and styling capabilities within Salesforce Experience Builder.


Desirable Skills:

  • Accessibility: Knowledge of WCAG 2.1 compliance and how to apply accessibility standards within a Salesforce environment.
  • Workshop Facilitation: Experience leading Design Thinking workshops or discovery sessions with clients.


Interpersonal Skills:

  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate business goals into logical user journeys.
  • Collaboration: Experience working in an Agile environment alongside Business Analysts and Salesforce Developers.
  • Storytelling: Strong ability to present design concepts and \"sell\" the UX vision to non-technical stakeholders.


Certifications:

  • Salesforce Certified User Experience (UX) Designer (Highly Preferred)
  • Salesforce Certified Strategy Designer (Desirable)
  • Google UX Design Professional Certificate or similar industry accreditation.


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, UI/UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or a related field.
  • Equivalent professional portfolio and work experience.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to design user-centered Salesforce experiences that transform complex business processes into intuitive and impactful solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


Work Schedule: Full-time (160-hours/month) working core EST US time zone.


Project timeline: May 4th to December 31st, 2026


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer)
description:
#Conheça um pouco sobre a área:


O propósito da squad SRE Cloud Data é implementar e administrar a infraestrutura cloud AWS responsável pela hospedagem dos bancos de dados, conectividade entre os serviços e stack de monitoramento/observabilidade utilizada na operação das nossas plataformas de GeoLocation , Go To Market Intelligence e de Reputação e Comunicação , utilizando estratégias de implementação de IAC, com confiabilidade e resiliência, apoiando as squads de desenvolvimento na operação e promovendo a cultura DevOps.


Nosso maior desafio é implementar, operar e monitorar a infraestrutura de forma escalável, com eficiência operacional e de custo, desenvolvendo automações para otimização do trabalho de SRE e provendo autonomia para os squads de engenharia.


#Desafios que você vai encontrar:

  • Gerenciar, administrar e evoluir ambientes de bancos de dados em produção e não-produção utilizando IAC
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade, performance, escalabilidade e confiabilidade dos bancos de dados
  • Planejar e executar estratégias de backup, restore, replicação e disaster recovery
  • Atuar em tuning, capacity planning e troubleshooting de bancos e integrações de dados
  • Atuar em incidentes, realizando RCA (Root Cause Analysis) e ações preventivas
  • Criar e manter runbooks e documentação de padrões
  • Garantir conectividade eficiente, segura e resiliente entre aplicações e bancos de dados na AWS
  • Atuar no planejamento, administração e otimização de custo dos recursos de rede na AWS (VPCs, Subnets, Route Tables, NAT Gateway, VPC Peering, VPC Endpoints, Transit Gateway, VPN etc)
  • Participar ativamente de diagnósticos de problemas de latência, perda de pacotes, timeouts e falhas de conexão
  • Trabalhar com IAM e políticas de acesso a recursos
  • Definir e acompanhar SLIs e SLOs para bancos de dados e padrões para monitoramento e observabilidade
  • Atuar com ferramentas como Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch
  • Apoiar estratégias de observabilidade orientada a confiabilidade


✔️ #Conhecimentos importantes para a posição:

  • Experiência prévia como DBRE em ambientes críticos de produção
  • Conhecimento sólido de implementação, escala, tuning e disaster recovery em ao menos dois dos seguintes bancos de dados: PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, SOLR, MongoDB, Oracle e Snowflake
  • Forte experiência com AWS, incluindo serviços de rede, conectividade, monitoramento e observabilidade
  • Conhecimento prático de Terraform (infraestrutura de bancos e rede como código)
  • Domínio dos conceitos de redes: TCP/IP, DNS, latência, throughput, timeouts
  • Automação com Shell, Python ou similares
  • Experiência com monitoramento, métricas e alertas de bancos de dados
  • Vivência em ambientes SRE/DevOps e atuação em incidentes de produção
  • Capacidade analítica para troubleshooting complexo (banco + rede + aplicação)
  • Experiência com EKS/Kubernetes integrando aplicações e bancos de dados


⭐ #Diferencial para a posição:

  • Conhecimento avançado em Elastic Stack (shards, índices, ILM, tuning)
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade
  • Mentalidade focada em redução de toil, automação e confiabilidade sistêmica


#PraVocê Nossos Beneficios:

PraVocê no dia a dia :

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação;
  • Gympass/TotalPass;
  • Auxílio home-office;


PraVocê & Família :

  • Plano de Saúde e Plano Odontológico (odonto é opcional);
  • Auxílio creche (até os 6 anos completos da criança):
  • Licença-Maternidade, Paternidade e Adotante Estendidas (#todasasfamíliasimportam);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Day Off de Aniversário (Um dia de folga para tirar no dia ou durante o mês do seu aniversário.);
  • Dia da Família (Um dia de folga para mamães e papais tirarem entre os meses de maio e agosto e aproveitar como quiserem.);
  • Pausa Mental (Uma semana corrida de folga em dezembro para que descansem e recarreguem as baterias.

*Benefícios de acordo com a política vigente*


PraVocê AINDA MAIS :

● Senso de propósito ao fazer parte de um time que está construindo algo que será perene e trará frutos para a sociedade, seja a Cortex em si enquanto \"startup\" em rápido crescimento que gerará cada vez mais empregos, seja o produto Plataforma Cortex, que será usado por cada vez mais usuários no Brasil e exterior.

title: [Dados] Engenharia de Dados Sênior - Inteligência Artificial LLM | Produto RH (Remoto)
description:
A missão do Especialista em Engenharia de Dados será atuar na arquitetura, construção e evolução do Data Lake e dos produtos de dados desenvolvidos pelo time, incluindo soluções de Analytics, agentes e modelos de machine learning.


Trabalhará em conjunto com outro especialista de engenharia de dados na definição e implementação de arquiteturas, modelagem e disponibilização de dados em ambientes distribuídos, utilizando tecnologias como AWS, Spark, Trino e Athena, além de viabilizar o consumo eficiente dessas informações por ferramentas como o Metabase.


Será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados, garantindo performance, escalabilidade, qualidade e governança das informações. Espera-se que o profissional atue com alta autonomia técnica, contribuindo para decisões de arquitetura e para a evolução contínua do ecossistema de dados, assegurando que as soluções atendam às necessidades analíticas e de inteligência dos produtos com robustez e confiabilidade.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Atuar na construção e evolução da arquitetura do Data Lake e dos produtos de dados do time (Analytics, agentes e modelos);
  • Desenvolver, otimizar e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis e confiáveis em ambiente AWS;
  • Modelar e estruturar dados para consumo analítico e operacional, garantindo qualidade, performance e governança;
  • Definir padrões, arquiteturas e boas práticas de dados;
  • Implementar e otimizar consultas e camadas de acesso a dados utilizando Athena e Trino;
  • Processar e transformar grandes volumes de dados utilizando Spark;
  • Garantir a disponibilização eficiente de datasets para consumo em ferramentas analíticas como Metabase;
  • Monitorar, diagnosticar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, queries e tabelas no Data Lake;
  • Assegurar qualidade, integridade e rastreabilidade dos dados ao longo de todo o pipeline;
  • Apoiar a definição de estratégias de particionamento, versionamento e organização de dados;
  • Contribuir com a documentação técnica e evolução das boas práticas de engenharia de dados;
  • Acompanhar tendências e propor melhorias contínuas no ecossistema de dados e nas tecnologias


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de dados, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados em larga escala;
  • Domínio de SQL avançado para manipulação e otimização de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Experiência prática com processamento distribuído utilizando Spark;
  • Experiência com serviços de dados na AWS (ex: S3, Glue, Athena, IAM, entre outros);
  • Experiência com engines de consulta distribuída, como Athena e/ou Trino;
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como Código (Terraform)
  • Experiência em streaming de dados em tempo real (Apache Kafka)
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL), não relacionais (MongoDB) e vetoriais (Milvus, Pinecone, S3 Vector)
  • Experiência em governança de dados (Apache Ranger)
  • Conhecimento em Data lake/lakehouse moderno (Iceberg, PyIceberg)
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de qualidade, governança e organização de dados;
  • Experiência trabalhando em conjunto com times multidisciplinares (dados, produto e engenharia);
  • Capacidade de estruturar soluções de dados escaláveis e de alta performance.


SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:

  • Experiência com disponibilização de dados para ferramentas de BI, como Metabase, Power BI ou Tableau;
  • Vivência com otimização de queries e particionamento de tabelas em Data Lake;
  • Experiência com orquestração de pipelines (ex: Airflow ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de Data Lake;
  • Experiência prévia suportando times de Ciência de Dados e Machine Learning;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de DataOps e observabilidade de pipelines;
  • Pós-graduação ou cursos especializados em Engenharia de Dados, Big Data ou Arquitetura de Dados.

title: Cloud AI/ML Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere.


Description

We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a \"cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models; you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services.

The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions.
  • Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data.
  • Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.g., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making.
  • Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations.
  • Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow.


Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations.
  • Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP) , Azure AI , or AWS SageMaker , specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.).
  • Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors.
  • Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows.
  • Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components.
  • Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments.


Profile Requirements

  • Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap.
  • Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build \"the bridge\" when a standard out-of-the-box tool doesn't exist.
  • Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders.
  • Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments.
  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better.
  • Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.


Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.


How your day will look like/Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends


Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships


Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors


Skills:

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)


Attitude:

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership TM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
- Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
- Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
- Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
- Advanced English (spoken and written),
- Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
- Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
- High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
- Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
- Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
- Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
- Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
- Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
- Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
- Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
- Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
- Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,
- Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,

Maintain deck equipment and carry out minor repairs as required.

Previous offshoreexperience (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);
Experience with deck operations and lifting equipment;

Especialista de Contabilidade I
FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA
Ensino superior completo em Contabilidade, com CRC ativo
Desejável pós-graduação ou MBA em Controladoria, Finanças, IFRS ou áreas correlatas

Conhecimento de normas internacionais (IFRS), especialmente IFRS 17, 9, 15 e 16;
Conhecimento na elaboração e análise de demonstrações financeiras consolidadas;
Experiência em empresas com estrutura societária complexa;
Vivência em processos de consolidação de demonstrações financeiras, incluindo eliminações, ajustes de consolidação e padronização de prática contábeis;
Excel e word avançado e experiência com ERPs (ex: SAP, Oracle, Totvs);
Inglês avançado a fluente (para comunicação em reuniões, principalmente).
Experiência prévia no mercado segurador/ressegurador será considerado um grande diferencial
MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO Garantir a adequada consolidação das informações contábeis, assegurando a conformidade com as normas contábeis brasileiras (CPCs), pronunciamentos internacionais (IFRS), e os regulamentos específicos da CVM, SUSEP e demais órgãos reguladores aplicáveis ao setor de resseguros.

Participação ativa nos fechamentos contábeis mensais e anuais, com foco na consolidação de resultados, incluindo entidades no exterior e eventuais processos de conversão entre diferentes práticas contábeis (GAAP);
Assegurar a correta elaboração e entrega das demonstrações financeiras e notas explicativas conforme exigido pela CVM (DFPs, ITRs, Formulário de Referência, Comentário de desempenho e etc.) e SUSEP;
Monitorar alterações nas normas contábeis e regulatórias (ex: atualizações do CPC, IFRS S1/S2, ofícios CVM e etc.) e mapear os impactos, assim como a sua implementação;
Analisar as operações societárias de empresas coligadas e controladas, inclusive para fins de equivalência patrimonial e consolidação;
Analisar criticamente os impactos contábeis em estruturas societárias complexas, incluindo operações de combinação de negócios (business combination);
Elaborar memorandos técnicos/contábeis.

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Job Title:AI Engineer
Position Type:Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration:Long Term
Work Schedule:8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Work Hours:PST
Location:100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)OverviewWe are seeking an experiencedAI Engineerto drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection ofDeveloper Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience withLLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.”Key Responsibilities
Champion anAI-first engineering culturethrough reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.
Define and measure impact usingDORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows.
Build reusable patterns for:
AI-assisted code generation
Pull request automation
Test generation
Debugging workflows
Developer self-service enablement
Evaluate, prototype, and leadPOCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.
Manage AI usage governance, including:
Token budgeting and cost controls
Usage monitoring and reporting
PII redaction guardrails
Audit logging and responsible AI practices
Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supportingLLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations.
Integrate AI tooling intoGit Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms.
Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.Required Qualifications
8+ years of experience inPlatform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles.
Strong hands-on experience withLLM APIs and AI-assisted developer toolingin production or enterprise settings.

title: Estágio em laboratório | nível superior
description:
British American Tobacco Brazil tem uma excelente oportunidade para um Estágio em laboratório | Nivel Superior
O estágio tem como objetivo proporcionar ao estudante uma experiência prática no ambiente de laboratório, atuando diretamente no suporte à resolução de não conformidades e na implementação de planos de ação para a melhoria contínua dos processos. O candidato terá a oportunidade de desenvolver habilidades técnicas e analíticas, contribuindo para a otimização das rotinas laboratoriais e para o fortalecimento da cultura de qualidade da empresa.
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:
Apoiar na identificação e análise de não conformidades nos processos laboratoriais.
Participar da elaboração e acompanhamento de planos de ação para melhorias de processos.
Auxiliar na documentação de procedimentos e controles de qualidade.
Colaborar com a equipe do laboratório na execução de testes e análises rotineiras.
Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos, sugerindo ideias e acompanhando resultados.
O que estamos buscando?
Estudante de graduação em Química, Engenharia Química ou áreas correlatas.
Afinidade com normas regulamentadoras (exemplo: ISO17025) para que as ações possam ser baseadas nos requisitos da norma.
Não é necessário experiência prévia, mas será considerado diferencial vivência em laboratório.
Conhecimento básico de inglês será valorizado.
Domínio do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point).
Boa comunicação, proatividade e capacidade de trabalho em equipe.
O QUE OFERECEMOS A VOCÊ?
Nossa gama de benefícios varia de acordo com o país e inclui diversos planos de saúde, iniciativas voltadas para equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, auxílio-transporte e um plano de férias flexível com incentivos adicionais
Sua jornada conosco não é limitada por fronteiras; é impulsionada por suas aspirações. Junte-se a nós na BAT e faça parte de um ambiente que prospera no crescimento interno, onde a progressão de sua carreira não é apenas uma declaração – é uma realidade que estamos ansiosos para construir juntos. Aproveite essa oportunidade e seja dono do seu desenvolvimento; seu próximo capítulo começa aqui.
Você terá acesso a plataformas de aprendizagem on-line e programas de desenvolvimento personalizados para aprimorar suas habilidades de liderança
Priorizamos a melhoria contínua em um ambiente transformador, preparando-nos para mudanças constantes
PORQUÊ JUNTAR-SE À BAT? Somos uma das poucas empresas nomeadas como Global Top Employer pelo Top Employers Institute - certificada em oferecer excelentes condições aos colaboradores.
A colaboração, a inclusão e a parceria estão na base de tudo o que fazemos na BAT. Estamos ansiosos pra proporcionar que cada indivíduo prospere, independentemente do género, orientação sexual, estado civil, mudança de género, raça, religião ou crença, cor, nacionalidade, origem étnica ou nacional, deficiência, idade, competências, experiência, educação, contexto socioeconómico e profissional, estatuto de veterano, perspectivas e estilos de pensamento. Sabemos que abraçar talentos de todas as origens é o que nos torna mais fortes e melhor preparados para atingir os nossos objectivos empresariais.
Encaramos as interrupções de carreira como oportunidades e não como obstáculos. Através do programa The Global Returners, apoiamos os profissionais que procuram reiniciar as suas carreiras após uma ausência prolongada da força de trabalho (por exemplo, tempo para cuidar da família, licença parental, serviço nacional, licença sabática e/ou iniciar um empreendimento próprio).
Venha trazer a sua diferença e veja o que é possível para você na BAT. Saiba mais sobre a nossa cultura e a nossa premiada experiência para os funcionários aqui . Se necessitar de quaisquer ajustes ou adaptações razoáveis para ajudar a ter o melhor desempenho possível durante o processo de recrutamento, encorajamos você a nos notificar. Estamos totalmente empenhados em apoiá-lo, tomando as medidas adequadas para que possa demonstrar todo o seu potencial.

title: Especialista em conteúdo
description:
Vaga: Especialista de Marketing de Conteúdo
Missão da Posição
O Especialista de Marketing de Conteúdo será responsável por estruturar e liderar a estratégia de conteúdo da Sprint, nova marca esportiva do Grupo AZZAS 2154 , apoiando sua construção desde o momento inicial até sua consolidação no físico e no digital. Seu papel será desenvolver a narrativa da marca, traduzindo seu posicionamento em conteúdos relevantes e consistentes, ampliando sua conexão com a comunidade e consolidando sua presença cultural no território esportivo.
Responsabilidades Principais:
- Desenvolver a estratégia de conteúdo da Sprint, definindo pilares editoriais, formatos e tom de voz.
- Liderar a implementação do Instagram e Tik Tok da Sprint, estruturando sua presença desde o início.
- Produção de conteúdo alinhado aos momentos estratégicos da marca em parceria com o time de Design e ferramentas de IA.
- Estruturar o calendário integrado de conteúdo alinhado a lançamentos, ativações comerciais e momentos institucionais da marca.
- Desenvolver e implementar a estratégia de influência, incluindo criação de playbook e gestão de parcerias com influenciadores em diferentes níveis (embaixadores, parceiros e creators).
- Construir briefings para áreas internas e parceiros externos, garantindo alinhamento entre conteúdo e execução.
- Acompanhar tendências, novos formatos, boas práticas e o universo esportivo, contribuindo para a evolução contínua das estratégias.
- Garantir consistência e amplificar a mensagem nos diferentes pontos de contato da marca, em parceria com as áreas responsáveis por cada canal.
- Atuar em interface direta com as áreas de Design, Mídia, CRM, Estilo, Produto e Planejamento.
- Acompanhar resultados e propor ajustes de rota com base em performance.
Requisitos e qualificações
- Experiência consolidada em marketing de conteúdo e atuação com influenciadores.
- Experiência com uso de ferramentas de IA aplicadas a marketing e criação de conteúdo.
- Experiência em varejo, moda, marcas esportivas ou bens de consumo.
- Perfil mão na massa, com vontade de construir, aprender e atuar em ambiente dinâmico.
- Graduação em Marketing, Comunicação, Publicidade, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
Diferenciais
- Conhecimento de inbound marketing e integração entre redes sociais e canais proprietários.
- Vivência em construção ou lançamentos de marca/produtos.
- Interesse pelo universo esportivo.

title: Operations assistant – rezeption & buchhaltung
description:
Über Digital Studio RioDigital Studio Rio unterstützt gastorientierte Betriebe mit modernen, digitalen Prozessen, klarer Kommunikation und verlässlichen Abläufen. Wir arbeiten serviceorientiert, pragmatisch und strukturiert – mit dem Ziel, dass im Hintergrund alles sauber funktioniert und Gäste sowie Teams sich auf reibungslose Prozesse verlassen können. Deine Mission
Du unterstützt unser Team in Rio in einer zentralen Backend-Rolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Rezeption, Gästeservice und Buchhaltung.
Dein Schwerpunkt liegt darauf, dass Buchungen, Folios, Zahlungen, Rückerstattungen und backendseitige Abläufe korrekt und nachvollziehbar bearbeitet werden.
Gleichzeitig bist du in der Lage, bei Bedarf auch operativ zu unterstützen und als Backup für die Rezeption bzw. Gästekommunikation einzuspringen. Deine Aufgaben
Bearbeitung und Prüfung von Folios, Buchungsdaten und Zahlungsinformationen im Backend
